purpose: Promote the P1C01 visible cast from name-coupled modular fallback presentation toward explicit hero character identity and asynchronous skeletal-rig presentation while preserving low-spec fallback behavior and canon-safe equipment state.

frodo.guardrail: Never present Frodo as a conventional power-fantasy warrior.
frodo.equipment_rule: Named gear is story-state driven and must not leak into earlier chapters.

gandalf.guardrail: Magic is rare and purposeful; presentation must not imply spam-casting.
gandalf.signature_presentation: Staff-led guide silhouette with bounded hero presentation.

source_scope.production_rule: Major characters need explicit visual identity, rig/skin/deformation/animation QC, and chapter/costume state rather than display-name-dependent asset ownership.

architecture.identity_contract: Stable ProductionCharacterId is separate from localized DisplayName.
architecture.fallback: Existing modular/static presentation remains visible until a complete skeletal mesh + AnimBP pair resolves.

acceptance.boundary: Source implementation candidate. Exact-head Pre-Unreal + UE4.27.2 pending; PIE/device/visual/deformation/performance remain separate evidence.
